lines.text: Many learners say: The man controls my ticket.
Better: The man checks my ticket.
Check means look to see if it is OK.
Checks! The man checks my ticket.

data.why: Check means look to see if it is OK.

native.tip: „Kontrollieren“ klingt wie „control“. Aber „control“ heißt „steuern“. Zum Prüfen sagen Sie „check“.

en.tip: “Kontrollieren” sounds like “control”. But “control” means “steuern”. To look at something, say “check”.
en.caption: “Kontrollieren” is not control! Wrong: “The man controls my ticket.” Right: “The man checks my ticket.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
